source.author: verg
source.text: Illi indignantes magno cum murmure montis circum claustra fremunt; celsa sedet Aeolus arce sceptra tenens, mollitque animos et temperat iras.
source.text_original: Illi indignantes magno cum murmure montis / circum claustra fremunt; celsa sedet Aeolus arce / sceptra tenens, mollitque animos et temperat iras.
source.text_english: There they, in anger, with a great murmur of the mountain, rage around the barriers; Aeolus sits on his high citadel, holding his sceptre, and softens their spirits and tempers their anger.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: cum iam prohibere frementum ora nequit, rex tune aditus et claustra refringit ipse volens placatque data fera murmura porta.
reuse.text_original: cum iam prohibere frementum / ora nequit, rex tune aditus et claustra refringit / ipse volens placatque data fera murmura porta.
reuse.text_english: when he can no longer restrain the roaring mouths, then the king himself breaks open the entrances and barriers and, the gate having been opened, soothes the wild murmurs.
